command:
printf 'CLOCK
'; date --iso-8601=seconds
printf '
MODE
'; systemctl get-default; systemctl is-active ssh NetworkManager automagic-fan nvargus-daemon
printf '
USER
'; id
printf '
USB
'; lsusb; lsusb -t
printf '
DEVICES
'; find /dev -maxdepth 1 \( -name 'ttyACM*' -o -name 'ttyUSB*' -o -name 'video*' -o -name 'media*' -o -name 'i2c-*' \) -printf '%M %u %g %p
'; ls -l /dev/snd
printf '
CAPTURE
'; arecord -l; arecord -L
printf '
PLAYBACK
'; aplay -l; aplay -L
printf '
V4L2
'; v4l2-ctl --list-devices; for f in /sys/class/video4linux/*/name; do [ ! -r "$f" ] || { printf '%s: ' "$f"; cat "$f"; }; done
printf '
SERIAL
'; ls -l /dev/serial/by-id /dev/pico-device 2>/dev/null || true
printf '
DEVICE_GROUPS
'; getent group audio video dialout render i2c gpio pico device-access; getent passwd pico 300seconds
